observed_structure: Each SIMDgroup owns one logical vocabulary row, with eight row owners sharing a threadgroup.
SIMDgroup lanes walk packed char4 columns with a literal stride of 32.
Each lane converts one char4 weight vector to FP32, takes its dot product with the corresponding float4 input, and applies the row-local scale selected per 16 char4 values.
An FP32 register accumulates the scaled vector dot products before simd_sum reduces them across the SIMDgroup.
Lane zero publishes the row score and token into threadgroup storage.
variant_notes: Out-of-range rows continue through simd_sum, then lane zero publishes negative-infinity and maximum-token sentinels.
A valid row whose reduced sum is NaN publishes negative infinity as its score while retaining the row token.
The cited span stages each row result as a score-token pair in threadgroup memory rather than writing it to a device output.
